title: Drogenerkennung im Straßenverkehr – Bilanz zu Schwerpunktkontrollen im Rahmen der 7. Berliner DiS-Tage

extraction.summaryEn: Police ran traffic checks on drug detection over three days (15–17 September 2026) at three Berlin locations during the 7th DiS days. A total of 1,330 vehicles and 1,366 people were checked, with 68 blood tests ordered.
